description: Frozen full-coverage W4A4 numerical-emulation protocol. All 479 eligible weight tensors use NVFP4; 476 executable Linear operators (469 ordinary plus seven category banks) use W4A4 activation QDQ. Three positional/embedding tensors are weight-only because they are not Linear operators. QAD and OPD keep a separate BF16 residual branch.

development.purpose: select W4A4 pressure and recovery settings

collection.purpose: training-only W4A4 QAD visited states for OPD

selection.selection_note: The selected checkpoint has 472 ordinary recipe tensors plus seven category-specific weight tensors, all NVFP4. Runtime activation installation reports 469 ordinary Linear operators plus seven category banks; three recipe tensors are embeddings/positional parameters and have no activation matmul.

quantization_scope.weight_format: NVFP4 E2M1 with E4M3 block scales and frozen PTQ tensor-scale contract
quantization_scope.activation_format: NVFP4 E2M1 with fixed secondary scale 1.0
quantization_scope.mode: W4A4 numerical QDQ emulation; FP4 base matmul plus raw-BF16 LoRA residual
quantization_scope.native_parity_status: GPU QDQ reference; APXInf native GR00T executor not claimed

reporting_metrics.micro_success_rate: total successes divided by all episodes; used for pressure screening
reporting_metrics.task_macro_success_rate: unweighted mean of ten task success rates; primary summary

primary_effect_minimum.note: The 160 paired episodes support 10-point recovery claims as the preregistered minimum; smaller differences are exploratory.
